# Asia Open: Supply Tightens, Prices Surge Across Core Segments  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter lead times and higher pricing; lock in volume now for high‑risk parts.

## What changed
- Market supply risk sits at 70.9 (‑0.4) and price trend at 85.2 (+0.4), both in the “Elevated” / “Rising fast” zones[1].  
- TSMC foundry loading is 50.9% YoY above typical, pushing supply tighter[3].  
- Global chip sales hit $172.6 B in Sep 2026, a 148.3% YoY surge, tightening both supply and price dynamics[2].  
- Semiconductor PPI rose 9.1% annualized over the last three months, adding upward pressure on prices[1].  
- Component book‑to‑bill is 1.05, indicating orders outpacing shipments[5].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**, stock **27,081** units, no on‑order quantity disclosed.  
- Price **$5.56** for qty 1, **$2.51** for 1 k units.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk **53.4** (Neutral) and price trend **69.5** (moderate rise).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Hold course** – 59 % chance prices rise but no strong timing signal[6].

## Alerts
- **Call change:** ATMEGA328P‑AU moves from “Lock pricing” to “Hold course” – 58 % chance of price rise; market is 7 % above target, so negotiate rather than wait[7].

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – supply 71.0 (0), price 82.1 – High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – supply 71.2 (0), price 84.3 – High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – supply 68.4 (+0.5), price 77.0 – High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – supply 66.7 (‑1.6), price 77.8 – High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – supply 66.3 (0), price 82.8 – High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **IRF540NPBF** – supply risk 83.1, lead time 38 weeks vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **SN65HVD230DR** – supply risk 81.8, lead time 26 weeks vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **LM358DR** – supply risk 81.6, lead time 26 weeks vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **W25Q128JVSIQ** – supply risk 81.4, lead time 52 weeks vs ~12‑week norm.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – supply risk 81.3, lead time 26 weeks vs ~12‑week norm.

## Outlook
- Chip prices next 3 months: 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.17 % (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge.  
- Chip prices next 6 months: 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.34 % (‑8.79 % to +17.46 %); trend‑following baseline.  
- Fab utilization next 3 months: 63 % chance supply tightens, expected +1.82 pts (‑1.71 to +5.36 pts); baseline.  
- Fab utilization next 6 months: 60 % chance supply tightens, expected +3.64 pts (‑2.16 to +9.45 pts); baseline.  
- Buy‑timing calls: secure supply for **10M08SAE144C8G**; lock pricing on the listed 20+ parts including **IRF540NPBF** and **LM358DR**; hold course on **ATMEGA328P‑AU** and others.

## Negotiation angle
- Push suppliers for **firm delivery dates** on the five watchlist parts; cite 2‑3× normal lead times as leverage.  
- Request **price caps or volume rebates** for the “Buy ahead / lock pricing” list, especially IRF540NPBF where price trend is high (71.5).  
- For neutral‑risk parts like IPB017N10N5ATMA1, negotiate **small‑batch purchases** now and defer larger orders until the 3‑month price outlook clarifies.
